video.title: Japan Summit 2026 | Growth, Reform & Japan’s Structural Uptrend

description:
At the Japan Summit 2026 co-hosted by Morgan Stanley and MUFG, Alberto Tamura, President and CEO of Morgan Stanley Japan, reflects on bringing together over 2,000 participants and 160 corporates to discuss Japan’s growth and reform momentum.  

Japan Equity Strategist, Sho Nakazawa shares why these quality discussions reinforce the Firm’s view that Japan is entering a structural uptrend, underpinned by stable inflation and rising wages, corporate governance reform, improvement in corporate profit, and CapEx-led growth.
